lines.text: The proverb says "Like mother, like daughter," and Jerusalem's mother was a Hittite and her father an Amorite.
Jerusalem's older sister Samaria lived to her north, and her younger sister Damascus lived to her south.

wrong_details.wrong: Damascus as the younger sister living to the south

lines.text: Sodom was arrogant, overfed and complacent, and Samaria did not commit half of Jerusalem's sins.
God will restore Sodom and Samaria but not Jerusalem, and the daughters of Edom and the Philistines scorn her.

wrong_details.wrong: God will restore Sodom and Samaria but not Jerusalem
wrong_details.true: God will restore Sodom and Samaria and also restore Jerusalem along with them

lines.text: Jerusalem despised the oath by breaking the covenant, yet God will establish an everlasting covenant and make atonement for her.
